pass_means: Single authoritative Lag_q from XI-A; a1,a2 defined; V3/V4 derived; Hessian at m=0 is -Box; sign mismatch with old catalogue repaired

authoritative_action.source: XI-A eq:scalar-action / eq:a1 / eq:a2 / eq:vertex / eq:V2 (via XVI-N provenance pin)
authoritative_action.Lag_q: (1/2) sqrt(-q) ( q^{mu nu} partial_mu phi partial_nu phi - m^2 phi^2 )
authoritative_action.Lag_eta: (1/2) ( partial_mu phi partial^mu phi - m^2 phi^2 )
authoritative_action.metric: q_{mu nu} = eta_{mu nu} + kappa gamma_{mu nu}
authoritative_action.a1: a1^{mu nu}[gamma] = (1/2) tau eta^{mu nu} - gamma^{mu nu}
authoritative_action.a2: a2^{mu nu}[gamma] = gamma^mu_rho gamma^{rho nu} - (1/2) tau gamma^{mu nu} + b2[gamma] eta^{mu nu}
authoritative_action.B_densitized_inverse_series: B^{mu nu}:=sqrt(-q) q^{mu nu} = eta^{mu nu} + kappa a1^{mu nu} + kappa^2 a2^{mu nu} + O(kappa^3)
authoritative_action.note_B_vs_qinv: a1,a2 are coefficients of the densitized inverse B, not of q^{mu nu} alone

V2_scalar_kin.density: (1/2) eta^{mu nu} partial_mu phi partial_nu phi   [m=0: mass term off]
V2_scalar_kin.sign_relative_to_old_catalogue: OLD V_scalar_kin used '-sqrt(-q) q^{mu nu} partial phi partial phi' (wrong overall sign and missing 1/2). REPLACED by +1/2 form.

V3_hphiphi.density: (kappa/2) a1^{mu nu}[h] partial_mu phi partial_nu phi   [m=0: no -m^2 b1 phi^2]
V3_hphiphi.a1_definition: a1^{mu nu}[gamma] = (1/2) tau eta^{mu nu} - gamma^{mu nu}
V3_hphiphi.matches_XI_A_V1: V_{1,g=1} = (1/2) int (a1^{mu nu} p_mu p_nu)  [eq:vertex at g=1, m=0]

V4_scalar_grav.density: (kappa^2/2) a2^{mu nu}[h] partial_mu phi partial_nu phi   [m=0: no -m^2 b2 phi^2]
V4_scalar_grav.a2_definition: a2^{mu nu}[gamma] = gamma^mu_rho gamma^{rho nu} - (1/2) tau gamma^{mu nu} + b2[gamma] eta^{mu nu}
V4_scalar_grav.matches_XI_A_V2: V_{2,g=1} = (1/2) int (a2^{mu nu} p_mu p_nu)  [eq:V2 at g=1, m=0]

hessian.free_action_m0: S0_phi = (1/2) int eta^{mu nu} partial_mu phi partial_nu phi
hessian.integration_by_parts: S0_phi = - (1/2) int phi Box phi  (compact support / total-deriv equivalence)
hessian.Euler_derivative: E_phi = delta S0_phi / delta phi = - Box phi
hessian.Hessian_at_m0_from_full: Full free Hessian is -(Box + m^2). At m=0 this specializes to -Box (NOT '+Box' and NOT bare 'Box').
hessian.old_error_withdrawn: o60-hard mass-policy text said Hessian -(Box+m^2) specializes to 'Box' at m=0; literal specialization is -Box.

vertex_tensor.V3_kernel: L_int = (kappa/2) a1^{alpha beta}(h) partial_alpha phi partial_beta phi
vertex_tensor.a1_variation: V^{alpha beta}_{mu nu} := partial a1^{alpha beta}/partial h^{mu nu} = (1/2) eta_{mu nu} eta^{alpha beta} - (1/2)(delta^alpha_mu delta^beta_nu + delta^alpha_nu delta^beta_mu)
vertex_tensor.note: Symmetric in (mu nu) and in (alpha beta). Used by D11 matter-loop subsector.

normalization_repair.withdrawn_catalogue_density: -sqrt(-q) q^{mu nu} partial phi partial phi
normalization_repair.replacement: + (1/2) sqrt(-q) q^{mu nu} partial phi partial phi  [m=0 kinetic]
normalization_repair.cubic_quartic_signs: Now visibly the kappa^1 / kappa^2 coefficients of the SAME Lag_q expansion (+ kappa/2 a1 and + kappa^2/2 a2), not independent guesses.
